title: Dues & ledger
structure: Topbar (h1 "Dues & ledger", then div.top-search with magnifier svg + span "Search unit or resident…", then div.top-right holding div.btn-outline-sm [download svg rotated 180deg + span "Export"] and div.btn-primary-sm [plus svg + span "New charge"]). The .content block, top to bottom: (1) div.subnav — four div.subnav-item children in order "Arrears command centre" (carries .active), "Charge schedule", "Payment plans", "Receipts". (2) div.age-kpi-row — a 5-column grid of div.age-kpi cards, each holding div.av then div.al: .age-kpi.total ($1.84M / Total outstanding, navy-800 ground, white value), .age-kpi.current ($612k / Current, #DCFCE7 ground), .age-kpi.d30 ($498k / 30 days, amber-100 ground), .age-kpi.d60 ($421k / 60 days, #FFE4D5 ground), .age-kpi.d90 ($309k / 90+ days, red-100 ground). (3) div.filter-row — seven div.f-chip pills: "All phases" (.active, navy-600/white), "Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Phase 4", "Phase 5", then a final chip "90+ days only" carrying inline style margin-left:auto;background:var(--red-100);color:var(--red-700); so it is right-aligned and red. (4) table.data-table — thead row of seven th: Household, Unit, Balance, Ageing, Last payment, Last reminder, and an empty seventh th. tbody has five tr. Column 1 is div.res-cell = div.res-avatar (initials) + wrapper with div.res-name and div.res-sub. Column 3 td carries class bal-amt. Column 4 holds div.age-badge with a bucket modifier class (current / d30 / d60 / d90). Column 7 holds div.row-actions > div.text-link-sm "View ledger". accounting_notes: AGEING SUMMARY (age-kpi-row), an accounts-receivable ageing of the member/unit control account. Headings and figures verbatim: "Total outstanding" $1.84M · "Current" $612k · "30 days" $498k · "60 days" $421k · "90+ days" $309k. TIE: the four ageing buckets sum exactly to the total — 612 + 498 + 421 + 309 = 1,840 (thousand) = $1.84M, so Total outstanding is a DERIVED control figure and must equal the sum of the buckets. The buckets are the four canonical AR ageing bands (0–29 / 30–59 / 60–89 / 90+ days past due). PER-UNIT SUBSIDIARY LEDGER: each table row is one unit's AR sub-ledger balance and its single worst ageing bucket — $12,400 (30 days), $31,600 (90+ days), $6,200 (Current), $18,600 (60 days), $44,900 (90+ days). These five rows are a partial list, so they do not sum to $1.84M; the full unit list must reconcile to the control total. Each unit balance is a debit balance on the AR control account (amount owed to the estate). "Last payment" dates the last credit posted to that unit's sub-ledger. No account codes, debit/credit columns or journal references appear on this screen.
